primary_metric: Macro mean V/U/R@16 over the four dev cases; both new variants share the frozen forced-backbone raw responses where prompts are identical, so only the joint variant uses fresh inference on dev.
split_rule: Same dev case IDs and seed schedule as the frozen protocols. Development pilot: the validity filter and the two-level joint stratification are compared here before freezing the test protocol.
method_definition: skeleton_complete_forced_valid applies validity-filtered assembly (greedy acceptance of model additions that keep the union acyclic, within budget and free of unwanted reachability) to the complete_forced prompt. skeleton_complete_forced_valid_joint additionally fixes a second node's feasible parent set within each stratum (two-level hierarchy) before the same filtered assembly. No coverage feedback, no edit actions, no representation change.
